content:
When running lake build on a project, it creates many files .setup.json, but those don't seem to be needed for subsequent runs of lake build. These can take up considerable space: in https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures this now ~3.5G. (This is not coming from mathlib, for that we use lake exe cache get, which doesn't download the .setup.json files as explained below)

For mathlib it seems that those .setup.json files are not shipped with the cache.
Is there some option to lake build to clean them up or not create them in the first place?

To reproduce in mathlib:

Running lake build on mathlib with lake exe cache get before: hardly any difference when deleting the setup.json files: 

~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> rm -rf .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1)) [1]> git checkout origin/master
HEAD is now at b037f4b18f feat(CategoryTheory/Sites): left adjoint is cocontinuous if and only if the right adjoint preserves covers (#36490)
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> rm -rf .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> lake exe cache get
[...]
Completed successfully!
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> lake build
Build completed successfully (8149 jobs).
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> du  .lake -d 0
6565628 .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> find .lake/build -name "*.setup.json" -delete
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> du  .lake -d 0
6565604 .lake

versus building Mathlib without cache: it creates 3402140K = 3.484 GB of (useless?) .setup.json files

~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> rm -rf .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> lake build                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Build completed successfully (8149 jobs).
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> du  .lake -d 0
10202568    .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> find .lake/build -name "*.setup.json" -delete
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> du  .lake -d 0
6800428 .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> lake build
Build completed successfully (8149 jobs).
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> du  .lake -d 0
6800428 .lake
~/mathlib4 ((b037f4b1))> math "10202568 - 6800428"
3402140

Is there some documentation about those.setup.json files; I search a bit and found setupFile, but not much info about them.
These files are passed by Lake to lean --setup when elaborating a module. They are regenerated on each build and thus can be deleted without issue.
ok, thanks! But they are not regenerated when the .olean files are already present right?
